observations: Photo 0: White industrial sewing machine on a stand; front/side view with needle area and presser foot visible.
Photo 1: Side view showing the long arm/bed and the handwheel; machine has a metal base and looks like it’s mounted on a table/stand.
Photo 2: Front view of the machine head mounted on a wooden/metal table; visible belt/drive area and wiring/hoses around the base.
Photo 3: Close side view of the machine head; brand name appears on the head and the stitch plate/bed area is visible.
not_shown: Whether it powers on and stitches properly (test run results)
Condition of the motor/drive system (if it uses a belt, whether belt and pulleys are intact and smooth)
Needle, presser foot, and feed dog condition (wear/bending)
Accessories included (extra needles, bobbins, attachments, foot pedal, power cable)
Exact model number/serial number (not readable in the photos)
Any rust, cracks, or oil leaks inside the head and under the table
Service history and whether it has been recently maintained
Working voltage/plug type and whether it’s compatible with Abuja power setup
